story.title: OpenAI's new voice intelligence API targets customer service, education, and creator platforms
story.summary: OpenAI has released new voice intelligence features for its API, enabling developers to build applications with advanced spoken-language understanding and generation capabilities across customer service, educational tools, and content creation platforms. The update lowers the barrier for businesses to deploy voice-first AI interfaces without building their own speech models. OpenAI says the features are designed for real-time, conversational use cases that go beyond simple transcription.
